title: v0.10.1 — Comprehensive Bug Audit & Remediation
description:
## Scope

Fix all 16 test failures identified in the v0.10.0 comprehensive bug audit (BUG-39 through BUG-54) and add structural preventive infrastructure.

### Production Bugs (3)
- **BUG-39** (HIGH): `build-session-context` omits buffered user message on first prompt
- **BUG-40** (HIGH): `close-session!` doesn't call `ensure-persisted!` — data loss on close
- **BUG-41** (LOW): Dead `#:strategy` parameter in `compact-history` — misleading API

### Test Bugs (13)
- **BUG-42**: `session-log-entries` doesn't filter `session-info`
- **BUG-43..47, 49, 53**: Dead `#:strategy` — compaction never triggers (8 failures)
- **BUG-48, 50..52**: Raw JSONL includes `session-info` header (4 failures)
- **BUG-54**: Critical hook test expects `'pass` but gets `'block`

### Preventive Infrastructure (4)
- Centralized `filter-session-info` helper for all JSONL test reads
- Compaction API contract assertion tests
- Session lifecycle smoke test (create→close→resume)
- First-prompt integration test (hooks + compaction check)

### Root Causes
1. Dead `#:strategy` parameter — 9 compaction tests use count-based but code is token-based
2. `session-info` version header — 5 test helpers don't filter it
3. `close-session!` gap — doesn't flush buffered entries
4. `build-session-context` gap — omits buffered user message on turn 1

Full analysis: `.planning/BUG_AUDIT_V0100.md`

title: v0.9.9 — TUI Workflow Testing & Scrollback Fix
description:
## Goal

Fix the scrollback render-cache ID collision bug (content window resets during tool-use turns) and establish comprehensive TUI workflow test infrastructure that simulates realistic user interactions end-to-end.

## Background

Bug analysis revealed that `tui-init.rkt` loads scrollback entries with IDs from a separate counter but never advances `ui-state.next-entry-id`. New runtime entries get colliding IDs → render cache returns stale lines → user sees old content.

More critically, there was **no integration test** connecting agent-loop events → TUI state → rendering. Tests for each layer existed in isolation but the bug lived in the interaction between them.

## Deliverables

- Bug fix: scrollback ID collision + render cache defense-in-depth
- New TUI workflow test harness (agent events → state → render pipeline)
- 20+ new tests covering scrollback, session resume, multi-turn tool cycles, render stability, event ordering
- Full regression suite passing

## Scope

5 waves, ~30 sub-issues, targeting 2026-04-30 completion.

title: v0.19.5 — CI Hardening
description:
Prevent CI breakage by catching all failure categories locally before push.

## Root Cause

After v0.19.4 release, CI was red for 10 consecutive commits (~3 hours lost). 7 distinct root-cause categories identified (C1–C7).

## Principle

**Local catches everything before push.** CI becomes a confirmation, not a discovery tool.

## Plan

See `.planning/PLAN-CI-HARDENING.md` for full details.

## Coverage

| Category | Root Cause | Wave |
|----------|-----------|------|
| C1 | Version drift across surfaces | W1 |
| C2 | Long lines in .rkt files | W1 |
| C3 | Stray local files (symlinks) | W5 |
| C4 | README metrics staleness | W1 |
| C5 | Missing deps in info.rkt | W2 |
| C6 | Tests assume out-of-repo paths | W3 |
| C7 | Hardcoded test assertions | W4 |
